svg.title: Wenyu Chiou. I study how people decide under flood risk, using surveys, simulation and LLM agents. Illustration: households on a floodplain decide, the river rises, and the outcome feeds the next decision.

g.text: I study how people decide under flood risk,
using surveys, simulation and LLM agents.
It starts with a survey: what would your
household do before the next flood?
the model: adapt, insure, or wait.
